operation_details.item: The user has a latex allergy and must avoid latex gloves and latex-containing art supplies.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! How are your creative projects coming along today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty good, thanks. I'm working on a detailed linocut print, but I had to stop because my hands are really irritated from the gloves I'm using.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I'm sorry to hear that. What kind of gloves are you using? Some materials can cause reactions.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I have a latex allergy; using latex gloves for craft work, model-making, or printmaking causes skin irritation and sometimes breathing issues.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's important to know. Latex is common in disposable gloves. For art supplies, you should switch to nitrile gloves, which are latex-free and provide good protection. Also, check labels on any adhesives, paints, or other materials you use—some contain latex.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks, I'll pick up some nitrile gloves. I also need to be careful with tape and erasers—I've heard some have latex.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. Many art erasers and some tapes contain natural rubber latex. Always look for 'latex-free' labels. For your printmaking, consider using a barrier cream as an extra precaution.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's a good idea. I'll get some barrier cream too. What about respirators? I sometimes use solvents for cleaning.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For solvents, a respirator with organic vapor cartridges is recommended. But since you have a latex allergy, make sure the respirator mask doesn't have latex in the straps or face seal. Many brands offer latex-free options.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Perfect, I'll check that. Thanks for the tips!
